newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: WTO admits Congo as 131st member.
newsitem.headline: WTO admits Congo as 131st member.

text.p: The World Trade Organisation (WTO) on Thursday admitted the Congo Republic as its 131st member, trade officials said.
The move was approved at a meeting of the WTO's ruling General Council.
Congo, a former French colony in western central Africa whose capital is Brazzaville, is one of the 47 states around the world recognised by the United Nations as least-developed, or LDC's.
The WTO will be holding a conference in Geneva in October this year to discuss how trade can be used to held LDCs emerge from endemic poverty.
